name: askai
description: Make AI coding subscriptions last longer: installs and wires up existing token-saving tools (RTK, Context Mode, Serena, markitdown, Caveman-style rules) for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex and Google Antigravity on Windows, macOS, Linux and WSL, with a hook-free session ledger, handoff and cheat sheet.
author: Aalok Shah
